<!-- pr-reviewer: 3b71ebd9e920ef0060400b4757f6bd3063f7c911 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review because the PR changes posted G-code. I reviewed the change against the current upstream `AGENTS.md`.

The engine refuses undeclared posts before the hooks run. The new footer actions follow the final retract. The UI uses the declared unit words. No G-code goldens, CL goldens, or snapshot PNGs changed.

Local build and test results:

The trial merge used upstream main `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f`. This head already contains that commit. The worktree was `.claude/worktrees/review-2208`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate: post, 64 test binaries | 589 passed |
| Quick gate: app, 211 test binaries | 1,799 passed; 1 failed; 2 ignored |
| Quick gate: UI, 7 test binaries, from `crates/ui` | 977 passed; 1 failed; 6 ignored |
| Clippy: post, app, UI; all targets; `-D warnings` | Passed |

All new EndUnits tests passed. The quick gate was not green. It had these two failures:

- `crates/app/tests/first_4axis_part.rs:60`, `the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program`:

  ```text
  the machine check: "Flat A-90: inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting"
  ```

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1896`, `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`:

  ```text
  egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in; hardware adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in
  ```

I ran each failed test again on upstream main in the same worktree. Each failed with the same diagnostic. The app failure is tracked in #2198. The UI failure is a graphics adapter limit on this machine. These are not findings against this PR.

Independent mutation checks:

- I restored `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs` to upstream main. `undeclared_post_refuses_end_units_by_name` failed because the post succeeded without a refusal. I restored the PR file. The test passed.
- I removed the new Fanuc footer action but kept its manifest declaration. `writing_mill_posts_emit_end_unit_word_before_program_end` failed: `fanuc: expected G20 right before M30`. I restored the action. The test passed across all seven switching posts.

All mutation changes were restored. Physical CNC controls, the interactive desktop application, and ignored release tests were not exercised.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:103` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_options.rs:100`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. The body has no screenshots for these changed controls. Show the Post dialog and Setup -> Post page. Include the Siemens word labels and the reset for an unsupported post. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not add images to this PR branch. This finding requires evidence; a source change is not required.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The missing UI screenshots are now in the PR body. They show the Post dialog and Setup → Post before and after the change. They include the Siemens `G700`/`G710` labels and the unsupported-post reset. The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `e8eb4073dea3d43927a400c82bb818c6e698bb1d`.

The existing test `dialog_and_post_page_offer_end_units_only_for_supported_posts` pins these controls. It passed after restoration (1 passed).
Mutation check: Reverting the two controls made the test fail because the Builtin post lacked `End in`. Restoring them made it pass.

Gate: RED. Post: 589 passed. App: 1,799 passed, 1 failed, 2 ignored. UI: 977 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored.
The two failures match the latest review:

- `first_4axis_part::the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program`: `Flat A-90` inputs moved.
- `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`: no graphics adapter.

The reviewer independently confirmed both failures on upstream main. They are outside this finding.
Clippy: GREEN. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed (exit 0).

This finding required evidence only. The source files remain unchanged. The images use a CPU render of the production egui controls. GPU capture failed with `No adapter found`. The PR head remains `3b71ebd9e920ef0060400b4757f6bd3063f7c911`.

Please re-review this head and the screenshots.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3b71ebd9e920ef0060400b4757f6bd3063f7c911 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review replaces my earlier change request on this head. The later evidence comment permits this review of the same head.

The earlier finding is met. I opened all eight images linked from the PR body. They show both controls before and after the change. The Siemens selectors show `G700` and `G710`. Both unsupported-post views show the reset action. The body identifies the images as headless renders of the production egui controls. The images are separate from the PR branch.

This is a safety-tier review because the change affects posted G-code. I checked the change against current upstream main's `AGENTS.md`. The engine refuses unsupported EndUnits requests before the post hooks run. The new unit words follow the final retract. No G-code goldens, CL goldens, or snapshot PNGs changed.

Local results:

I trial-merged the head with upstream main `a14fa0c8da4613a9fb44112627ebb6e1a8b113d1`. The merge was clean. All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2208`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: post, 65 binaries | 596 passed |
| Quick gate: app, 212 binaries | 1,811 passed; 2 ignored |
| Quick gate: UI, 7 binaries, from `crates/ui` | 977 passed; 1 failed; 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

All EndUnits tests passed. The app failure from the earlier review is absent on this trial merge.

The quick gate remains red because `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` fails at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1896`:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in; hardware adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in
```

I ran that test on current upstream main in the same worktree. It failed with the same diagnostic. This machine has no suitable graphics adapter. This failure is not a finding against the PR.

Independent mutation checks:

- I removed the new refusal check from `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`. `undeclared_post_refuses_end_units_by_name` failed because the unsupported post succeeded. I restored the check. The test passed.
- I removed the new Fanuc footer output and kept its manifest declaration. `writing_mill_posts_emit_end_unit_word_before_program_end` failed: `fanuc: expected G20 right before M30`. I restored the output. The test passed across all seven switching posts.

Both mutations were red, then green after restoration. The worktree had no source changes after restoration.

Requested before merge: none. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE` for the reviewed head.

Physical CNC controls, the interactive desktop application, and ignored release tests were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
